fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, perimeter fence, or pinch-point checkpoint at the property entrance. The site is reached by a long open access drive (Stow Dr) off NH Route 9; Street View (2023-06) shows the Google car drove the access road unobstructed straight into the truck court. Open site.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth structure anywhere along the access drive or at the truck court entrance.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no truck gate at all.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide open paved truck court on the NE/E side of the building serves as an interior holding/queue area before trucks reach the dock face; ample room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Access drive from Route 9 to the truck court is roughly 250m of open paved road — easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Single continuous dock bank on the west building face; ~30-36 trailers backed in nose-out in z18/z19 imagery. 319,000 sq ft DC. 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No dedicated marked drop-yard; trailers without tractors appear parked in the open truck court and along the access road. Estimate 10-25; flagged uncertain — no striped trailer stalls visible.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural wooded setting in West Chesterfield NH but adjacent to NH Route 9 (a state highway) with a small industrial cluster nearby — cellular coverage likely adequate; set false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main DC plus an attached/adjacent office wing on the NW corner; counted as 2.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property; nearest rail is well away from the site.
